name: opusforge-gorilla-mcp
description: Lead discovery for solo SaaS founders. Searches Reddit, X, YouTube, and TikTok for posts where people describe a problem your product solves, ranks each by buying intent, and returns ranked leads. Includes `find_leads`, `draft_outreach`, and `plan_acquisition_funnel` for the full acquisition flow. Hosted, $0.99 per run. Install: `npx -y github:opusforge/gorilla-mcp`. Sign up: [usegorilla.app](https://usegorilla.app).
